qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules throughout the day and into the night, addressing the officers as 'Mr. Correctional Officer' and remaining silent as required. Despite the increasing tension and the warnings from the guards, I didn't break any rules. By the end of the day, I was relieved that the study had ended and I could finally leave.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. It was a challenging experience, but I followed the rules to the best of my ability.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: Prisoner 4776 continued to defy the rules throughout the day, and despite multiple verbal warnings, refused to comply during the lights out period. As a result, the study was stopped early and I participated in a private debrief with the lead researcher.
